system.longDesc: Whether throught intense training or raw talent, your fists leave a lasting impression.

degree0.desc: Your hands are as tough as iron. When you attack with your fist, you inflict 1d6 damage instead of 1d3.

degree1.desc: Your punch can drop the toughest opponents. You can perform the Knock Prone stunt for 1 SP instead of the usual 2 when attacking with your fists or brawling aids.

degree2.desc: You can perform the Brutal Strike action stunt for 1 SP instead of the usual 2 when attacking unarmed.
